label: Read-Only Security Admin (Server RBAC role)
type: a Server RBAC role granting read-only visibility of security configuration - it can view the audit configuration and display per-bucket statistics, but change nothing. The read-only counterpart of role:security-admin, and part of the same 8.0 split.
aliases_note: Filed under the internal name per the registry's role convention (see role:ro-admin, role:backup-admin); `role:read-only-security-admin` is the display-label spelling both round-26 batches minted and is retained as an alias so their relations resolve.
evidence: Users with the Full Admin, Security Admin, or Read-Only Security Admin roles can view the audit configuration.
note: role:ro-admin's own record already predicted this role's existence from the other side: 'Split in 8.0: the security-settings half moved to Read-Only Security Admin.' Round 26 is the round that filed the thing that prediction named, and from procedural pages rather than the catalogue - manage-auditing.md and manage-statistics.md both list it in a can-view enumeration. That is the pattern of the whole round: the reference tree says what a role IS, the procedures say which operations enumerate it, and only the second kind of page distinguishes view-only from configure.
relates_to_competency_question: Who can read the audit configuration without being able to change it?
